podcasts.title: Humans in a Post-Human World
podcasts.transcript:
I’ve spent more than forty years writing software. AI agents now write it better than I do. My daughter Athena is fourteen and earns straight A’s in high school. How do I help her choose a career when her AI study partner will likely do that work better than she can?

Today those agents are my teammates, and I still decide what we’re trying to build. If machines eventually do all the work, where does that leave me? And who earns the money to buy what they make?

podcasts.title: Implementing Federated Learning to enhance Agentic AI
podcasts.transcript: How can AI models learn from private data without compromising privacy? Chris is joined by Lorenzo Sani, Research Scientist at Flower Labs and PhD researcher at Cambridge, to explore federated learning and privacy-preserving AI. They discuss how collaborative learning can expand access to private data for LLM training, how model trajectories can help improve agentic AI systems, and the benefits of open-weight models.
